audit_items.proof_trace: The implementation body is `return allowedUris.includes(redirectUri)`, which is definitionally identical to the assertion `allowed.includes(uri)`. Array.prototype.includes() uses SameValueZero (strict string equality) — no URL normalization, no wildcards, no prefix matching. The caller passes redirectUri as a raw unprocessed query-param string, so no pre-processing transforms the value before comparison.
